summary: Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S. filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, announcing the planned release of its first-quarter 2026 financial results on May 11, 2026, after Borsa Istanbul trading hours. The filing is a routine earnings calendar update, not related to any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. There is no deal terms, board recommendation, or structural change. This is a standard ongoing reporting obligation under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16, and accordingly falls under 'None' as it does not involve a special event.
